FN-UNT3GXD-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 129
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 129 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government could
reduce expenditures and potential receipts to state agencies, higher education institutions, and
local boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent upon: (1) the amount currently
expending by these entities on the activities prohibited by this bill; and (2) the amount of
funding that otherwise would have been awarded to any of these entities if not for the
prohibitions, provided by this bill, of applying for, or accepting, federal or private funding for
the purpose of compelling assent to any divisive concepts or any other purpose prohibited in this
bill.
Page 1
